author: JustBudah
body:
Hello everyone, I have been noticing this for a while now and I want to change it. The problem is that nobody is using the "Points Shop".So I am here to bring you my opinion of the "Points Shop" and what I think is the best so people are going to use it more. So lets get started; I think we need get rid off a couple of potions and add the grenades back(yes, I know, 5 grenades is to much but make it 2 or 3) I want this to be added back because alot of donators dontate mostly for choosing teams and grenades and other cool stuff. This is the only thing what comes up in my mind, so if you read this and think of some more ideas, please give me/ the server feedback!

Ty- Beyrdo

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
IMO, keep grenades out. They are too OP and it would be harder to kill killfarmers. They do just about the same damage as you would if you took a flying TNT in the face (Experience)

I suggest thst the spanky spade lowers down to 10 points, however, a more powerful version is replaced with the current version w/ knockback II.

Now, add back the TNT. Make all items in the points shop available to everyone.

If you truly want more donors, then you guys need to make some additions like a currency system and buying stuff to unlock ingame. Like buying killstreaks.

Depending on the donor's level they'd get more "coins" as akin to that of how they level up ingame.
